title: fs.exists is deprecated
summary: Node.js documents fs.exists(path, callback) as deprecated (DEP0034, documentation-only since v1.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace fs.exists
steps.instructions: Replace each reported fs.exists call with fs.access or fs.stat and handle the error instead of the boolean.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
